## PART 1: NAVBAR AUDIT

### Desktop Navigation Links (in order):
1. **Solutions** (dropdown)
2. **How It Works** (direct link)
3. **Pricing** (direct link)
4. **Our Work** (direct link)
5. **Our Mission** (direct link)
6. **Resources** (dropdown)

### Dropdowns:

**Solutions Dropdown:**
- Web Development
- UI/UX Design (Coming Soon)
- Graphic Design (Coming Soon)
- App Development (Coming Soon)

**Resources Dropdown:**
- Blog
- Help Center (external)

### Sticky Scroll Behavior:

**Trigger Point:** 300px on desktop, 350px on mobile (max-width: 767px)

**CSS Changes when sticky** (`.navbar.sticky`):
- Position: `fixed` (absolute to fixed)
- Top: `0`
- Width: `96%` (from 100%)
- Border: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)` (new)
- Backdrop filter: `blur(6px)` with `-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px)` (new)
- Background: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)` (from solid white to semi-transparent)
- Border-radius: `10px` (new)
- Box-shadow: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 4px 16px -4px` (new)
- Transform: `translateY(10px)` (slides down 10px on trigger)
- Transition: `0.5s ease` on transform and background-color

### Mobile Hamburger Menu:

**What shows on mobile (max-width: 767px):**
- Menu toggles to a full-width overlay at top (inset: 0%, top: 100%)
- Background color: `#082753` (dark blue)
- Flex-flow: column (vertical stack)
- Padding: 10px 4%
- Border-bottom: 1px solid #c9d2d9 on tablet, none on mobile

**Animation:**
- Hamburger button: 48px × 48px black rounded button (displays at max-width: 991px)
- On mobile (max-width: 479px): button is 40px × 40px with 1px solid #21cfff border
- Hamburger lines: 3 lines, 20px × 2px, with 4px gap, transform-origin center
- Dropdown arrows rotate 180deg on open
- On mobile, all nav links and dropdowns turn white text on #082753 background

**Hamburger Button Styles:**
- Default (tablet, max-width: 991px): background #000, border-radius 10px, width/height 48px
- Mobile (max-width: 479px): border: 1px solid #21cfff, border-radius 8px, 40px × 40px
- On open state (w--open): stays same color but displays open menu

### CTA Buttons in Nav:

| Label | Link | Styles |
|-------|------|--------|
| **Login** | https://portal.boldteq.com/ (external) | `.button-secondary-large` - transparent bg, #082753 text, 1px #082753 border, border-radius 10px, padding 8px 20px. On hover: white text, #082753 bg. Desktop font-size 13px, mobile 16px |
| **Schedule Demo** | /book-a-demo | `.btn-primary` - gradient bg (linear-gradient 90deg #21cfff to #019ae6), white text, background image overlay at 93%, border-radius 0.75rem, padding 8px 3rem 8px 1rem. Desktop: font-size 16px. Mobile: font-size 0.8rem |

### CSS Issues Found:

1. **Login button padding inconsistency**: 8px 20px (desktop) vs responsive breakpoints don't clearly show padding adjustments until 1440px (10px top/bottom)
2. **Schedule Demo button**: Background image positioning at 93% may be cut off on smaller screens (background-size: 26px on mobile vs auto on desktop)
3. **Sticky navbar backdrop**: Only applies at 300px/350px, but transforms down 10px which may cause visual jump
4. **Mobile menu padding**: inconsistent between tablet (2%) and mobile (4%)
5. **Hamburger button on mobile**: Border color (#21cfff) doesn't match dark theme of menu background (#082753)

---

## PART 2: WEBFLOW CSS FOR HOMEPAGE SECTIONS

### Section Styling Summary:

| Section | Background Color | Padding | Margin | Border-radius |
|---------|------------------|---------|--------|----------------|
| **.section-regular** (Logos) | #fff | 0 5% | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.banner-section** | #082753 | 10px 5% | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.works-sec** (Portfolio/Works) | #0000 (transparent) | 20px 5% 60px | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.faq-section** (Comparison/FAQ) | (inherits, has bg image) | 60px 5% 70px | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.boldteq-removes-sec** (Resolution Banner) | #0000, or #082753 if .blue-sec | 0 5% 80px (or 0 if .center-sec) | (not specified) | 20px (.remove-flex child element) |
| **.built-sec** (Built-For Section) | #0000, or #082753 if .blue-sec | 0 5% 80px (or 0 if .center-sec) | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.ways-sec** (Pain Points) | (not set) | padding-left 5%, padding-right 5% | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.new-price-sec** (Pricing) | #fff (or #0000 if .pricing-page-newsc) | 80px 5% 20px | margin-bottom 0 | (none) |
| **.how-work-sec3** (How It Works) | (not set) | 128px 5% (or 60px if .overflow-hidden) | (not specified) | (none) |
| **.how-works-banner** | #0000 | 4rem top/bottom | (not specified) | (none) |

### Card & Component Styling:

| Component | Background Color | Border | Border-radius | Padding |
|-----------|------------------|--------|----------------|---------|
| **.feature-card** (How-It-Works Steps) | #def4ff | 1px solid #009ce0 | 20px | 25px 17px 17px |
| **.feature-card.blue** (Blue variant) | #1c3861 | 1px solid #ffffff1c | 20px | 25px 17px 17px (or 25px bottom if .padding-btm) |
| **.remove-flex** (Boldteq Removes Banner) | #21cfff with gradient overlay #019ae6ab | (none) | 20px | 40px |
| **.gray-bg** (Ways Section) | #f4f7fa | (none) | 20px | 30px 40px |
| **.skycolor-bg** (Ways Section alt) | #21cfff12 (light cyan) | (none) | 20px | 30px 40px |

### Notes on Missing/Hidden Sections:

- `.boldteq-removes-sec` and `.built-sec` both have `display: none` in base styles (hidden by default)
- `.benefits-sec` was not found in CSS (may be named differently or integrated into other sections)
- `.price-card`, `.comp-table`, `.compare-table` were not found (pricing may use `.feature-card` or other naming)
- `.how-works-pricing-sec` exists (line 13270) but wasn't queried
- Pricing section uses `.new-price-sec` instead of `.price-sec`

### Gradient & Advanced Styling:

- **Gradient text**: `.cont-subhead` uses background-image: linear-gradient(#21cfff, #019ae6) with -webkit-background-clip: text
- **Gradient overlays**: `.remove-flex` has nested gradient overlay: linear-gradient(#019ae6ab, #019ae6ab)
- **Backdrop blur**: Only used in `.navbar.sticky` (blur 6px)
